extra.description: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. Inspired by the use of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, we propose CellMSA, a single-cell representation learning framework that introduces an MSA-inspired inductive bias into transcriptomic modeling. For each target cell, CellMSA retrieves relevant cells from different batches and biologically related cell types as context, and summarizes cross-cell patterns into a context-dependent gene-pair representation. This representation is then injected into a pair-aware target-cell encoder for fine-grained representation learning. We pretrain CellMSA on a large-scale human single-cell corpus of approximately 109 million cell observations, including 65.6 million primary observations. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at the following repository: https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA.

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 了解基因表达到图像的学习：空间结构和信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 能够在细胞水平上分析生物异质性，但从高维、无序的基因表达谱中学习有效的表示仍然具有挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过在卷积神经网络的像素网格上排列基因值提供了一种有效的学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究 GE2I，同时保持网络和训练程序固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑度和基因水平保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配给同一像素会掩盖表达差异，并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑度降低，一对一的基因到像素分配也可以改善测试视觉主干的预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的好处取决于主干和映射。这些发现为基因表达数据之前的像素分配和视觉转移提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: GenDiMug: a generic inclusive multigraph framework to analyze genomic organizations and -omics data at multiple scales
items.title_zh: GenDiMug：一个通用的包容性多图框架，用于分析多个尺度的基因组组织和组学数据
items.summary_zh: 经过数十年的研究，基因组组织的分析仍然具有挑战性。这是因为基因组描述信息非常丰富，并且通常呈现为与核酸大分子骨架上的位置间隔的有序列表相对应的基因组特征的线性图。这种形式虽然准确，但并没有完全优化以数学分析所有基因组结构特性，特别是基因组特征之间的关系，也没有整合大量的组学数据，例如转录组、表观基因组、蛋白质组、熔体组或染色质可及性数据，这些数据越来越可用。因此，我们开发了 GenDiMug，这是一种使用基因组网络表示作为骨干的工具，提供了一个自然框架来整合基因组特征和多组学数据之间的空间和个体发生关系。我们说明了如何将这种通用方法应用于各种基因组，既可以在重叠群和染色体尺度上以碱基对分辨率可视化基因组拓扑，又可以使用各种图形指标分析基因组位置效应。使用 GenDiMug，我们进一步揭示了真核基因组中具有相似表达水平的基因的聚集及其在光合藻类中可能的昼夜节律调节。

extra.description: After decades of investigation, analyses of genome organization remain challenging. This is because genome descriptions are very information-rich and usually rendered as a linear map of genomic features corresponding to an ordered list of position intervals on a nucleic acid macromolecular backbone. This formalism, while accurate, is not fully optimized to mathematically analyze all genome structural properties, in particular the relations between genomic features, nor to integrate large amounts of -omics data, such as transcriptomes, epigenomes, proteomes, meltomes or chromatin accessibility data, which are increasingly available. We therefore developed GenDiMug, a tool that uses a network representation of the genome as a backbone, providing a natural framework to integrate spatial and ontogenetic relationships between genomic features and multi-omics data. We illustrate how this generic approach can be applied to all sorts of genomes, both to visualize genomic topology at contig and chromosomal scales at base-pair resolution, and to analyze genome positional effects using various graph metrics. Using GenDiMug, we further reveal clumping of genes with similar expression levels in eukaryotic genomes and their possible circadian regulation in a photosynthetic alga.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
items.title_zh: CircuitATLAS：在系统神经科学知识图谱上进行代理推理以发现 circuitopathies 中的靶点
items.summary_zh: 神经疾病药物发现传统上聚焦于疾病改变的分子。但导致病理的分子未必是逆转病理的最佳切入点。在此，我们追问哪些原本未被改变的分子控制点可以被用来将病理神经环路恢复至功能状态。我们提出CircuitATLAS，一个基于溯源的系统神经科学知识图谱和智能体框架，用于环路病中的靶点发现。它结构化地整合了来自文献的跨疾病、表型、电生理、环路、脑区、细胞类型和分子效应器的关系，同时刻意排除直接的疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白边以减少捷径推理。该图谱包含383万个节点和766万条边，其中包括531万条LLM提取的关系，并整合了人类细胞图谱等结构化数据集和新的多模态在体测量。随后我们引入一个智能体工作流，从可测量的疾病表型出发，经由其环路和细胞基质，推理至分子干预、治疗可行性和临床约束。最后，我们引入一个人工治理的在体实验室在环，将假设生成与实验迭代连接起来。在该框架内，一个智能体提名ATP1A3——神经元alpha

extra.description: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: Orchestra: Corroboration-Based Regulatory Candidate Discovery via Composed Bioinformatics MCP Agents
items.title_zh: Orchestra：通过组合生物信息学MCP智能体进行基于佐证的调控候选发现
items.summary_zh: Orchestra将两个独立构建的生物信息学MCP服务器——RegNetAgents（从ARACNe网络推断基因调控网络拓扑）和CASCADE（提供四个独立证据源：LINCS敲低、DepMap必需性、超级增强子状态、DoRothEA转录因子置信度）——组合成一个通过模型上下文协议暴露的多智能体工作流。其核心架构主张是，要求RegNetAgents的拓扑证据和CASCADE的实验证据在候选调控因子上达成一致，比任一单独来源产生更可信的候选——此前未直接测试，因为RegNetAgents自身的验证仅询问其候选列表是否优于随机。我们在TCGA肿瘤获得性调控因子层级（基因肿瘤ARACNe网络中但不在GREmLN群体平均基线中的调控因子）上测试，通过ARACNe互信息（MI）边权重选择候选。在RegNetAgents已发表的BRCA/COAD焦点基因面板及匹配阴性对照上，CASCADE 4个来源中至

extra.description: Orchestra composes two independently built bioinformatics MCP servers -- RegNetAgents, which infers gene regulatory network topology from ARACNe networks, and CASCADE, which supplies four independent evidence sources (LINCS knockdown, DepMap essentiality, super-enhancer status, DoRothEA transcription-factor confidence) -- into one multi-agent workflow exposed via the Model Context Protocol. Its central architectural claim is that requiring RegNetAgents' topology evidence and CASCADE's experimental evidence to agree on a candidate regulator yields a more trustworthy candidate than either alone -- not previously tested directly, since RegNetAgents' own validation asked only whether its candidate lists beat chance. We test this on the TCGA tumor-acquired regulator tier (regulators in a gene's tumor ARACNe network but absent from the GREmLN population-averaged baseline), selecting candidates by ARACNe mutual-information (MI) edge weight. On RegNetAgents' published BRCA/COAD focal-gene panel plus matched negative controls, agreement among at least 2 of the 4 CASCADE sources predicts OncoKB cancer-gene status among focal genes (odds ratio 2.89, Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted p=0.0166) but not among negative controls (p=0.0721); a single source is not diagnostic for either group. The pattern replicates and strengthens in a third cancer type, STAD, on a separately constructed panel (odds ratio 5.82), and against an independently curated ground truth (the Sanger COSMIC Cancer Gene Census). MI edge weight is the strongest single predictor overall (p=0.0003); a logistic-regression likelihood-ratio test confirms corroboration adds value beyond it in both panels (p=0.0234; p=0.0001). Every experiment invokes Orchestra's real agentic entry point.

items.title: Lost in the Fallback: How Reliably Do Typed Decision Models Use Fallback Options?
items.title_zh: 迷失在后备中：类型化决策模型使用后备选项的可靠性如何？
items.summary_zh: 类型化决策模型 (TDM) 越来越多地用于请求路由和模型选择等应用程序，从而做出对系统性能至关重要的可靠决策。后备选项可容纳常规选择之外的类别，从而能够推迟到人类专家或更强大的模型。虽然最近的工作已经研究了 TDM 中的对抗性漏洞，但它们在非对抗性环境中遵循后备规则的能力仍未得到充分探索。我们引入配对回退鲁棒性（PFR）测试来评估回退可靠性的两个方面：模型是否在常规选项和回退选项之间正确切换，以及它们是否在同一规则的逻辑等效定义下做出一致的决策。我们根据三个基准评估开源决策模型，并在架构和参数计数之间进行受控比较。我们发现，正确的识别并不能可靠地转移到正确的后备选项，即使明确提供了正确的类别，错误仍然存​​在。此外，同一后备规则的逻辑等效表述也可能在模型决策中产生重大分歧。这些发现揭示了当前 TDM 中一个关键的可靠性差距：旨在提高可靠性的后备机制反而会引入错误。它强调了后备规则的忠实执行

extra.description: Typed decision models (TDMs) are increasingly used in applications such as request routing and model selection, making reliable decisions critical to system performance. Fallback options accommodate categories outside regular choices, enabling deferral to human experts or more capable models. While recent works have examined adversarial vulnerabilities in TDMs, their ability to follow fallback rules in non-adversarial settings remains underexplored. We introduce the Paired Fallback Robustness (PFR) Test to evaluate two aspects of fallback reliability: whether models correctly switch between regular and fallback options, and whether they make consistent decisions under logically equivalent definitions of the same rule. We evaluate open-source decision models on three benchmarks, with controlled comparisons across architectures and parameter counts. We find that correct recognition does not reliably transfer to correct fallback options, and errors persist even when the correct category is explicitly supplied.Moreover, logically equivalent formulations of the same fallback rule can also produce substantial disagreement in model decisions. These findings reveal a crucial reliability gap in current TDMs: fallback mechanisms designed to improve reliability can instead introduce errors. It highlights faithful execution of fallback rules and consistency under equivalent definitions as essential requirements for reliable typed decision-making.

items.title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
items.title_zh: 离散扩散和自回归语言模型的能耗分析
items.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 的不断扩展，推理过程中的能耗已成为一个关键问题。虽然自回归 (AR) 模型是行业标准，但扩散语言模型 (DLLM) 已成为能够并行令牌生成的有前途的替代方案。在本文中，我们对扩散模型（LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B）与 AR 模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B）进行了能量基准比较。我们分析了模型架构、KV 缓存优化和每令牌焦耳效率之间的权衡。我们的结果表明，在较长的序列（200--600 个令牌）下，扩散模型可实现 2.5--2.7 J/令牌，比带有 KV 缓存的 AR 模型（5.3--5.7 J/令牌）效率大约高 2 倍\倍。 KV 缓存为较长序列的 AR 模型提供了巨大的好处（节能 50--70%）。

extra.description: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale, their energy consumption during inference has become a critical concern. While Autoregressive (AR) models are the industry standard, Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative capable of parallel token generation. In this paper, we perform a comparative energy benchmark of diffusion models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) against AR counterparts (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B). We analyze the trade-offs between model architecture, KV-cache optimization, and Joules-per-token efficiency. Our results show that at longer sequences (200--600 tokens), diffusion models achieve 2.5--2.7 J/token, approximately 2$\times$ more efficient than AR models with KV-cache (5.3--5.7 J/token). KV-cache provides substantial benefits for AR models at longer sequences (50--70\% energy reduction).

items.title: Teaching Agents in their Own Style: Blackbox Teacher Distillation for Web Agents
items.title_zh: 以自己的风格教授代理：网络代理的黑盒教师蒸馏
items.summary_zh: 使用封闭模型的前沿网络代理具有很高的推理和计算成本。较小的开放模型可以是一种替代方案，但为了提高性能，它们需要人类或教师模型的训练监督。令牌级教师蒸馏对于封闭式教师来说不是一个选择，因为它需要访问模型的 logits。标准方法是离线模仿教师演示，但它会以学生从未访问过的状态以及不写入的风格来训练学生。我们引入了 WebKD，其中教师是学生失败的编辑。给定一个失败的情节，老师找到第一个错误点，并重写学生从该点开始的推理轨迹、利用状态和行动。编辑显示，教师的更正可能比学生自己的文本更让学生感到惊讶。相反，WebKD 的目标是进行最少的编辑。在数据空间中，老师以学生的风格写下每一个更正。在客观空间中，推理根据其对行动的贡献进行加权。角色不对称的 KL 锚允许纠正的动作自由移动，同时保持推理接近学生的先验。在 TimeWarp 基准上，WebKD 学生比行为克隆、结果奖励强化学习和教师编辑基准获得

extra.description: Frontier web agents using closed models have high inference and computational costs. Smaller open models can be an alternative, but to be performant, they require training supervision from a human or teacher model. Token-level teacher distillation is not an option for closed teachers as it needs access to the model's logits. The standard approach is to imitate teacher demonstrations offline, but it trains the student on states it has never visited, and in a style it does not write in. We introduce WebKD, where the teacher is the editor of the student's failures. Given a failed episode, the teacher finds the first point of mistake, and rewrites the student's reasoning traces, harness states, and actions from that point onward. The editing reveals that the teacher's corrections can be more surprising to the student than the student's own text. WebKD instead aims to edit minimally. In the data space, the teacher writes each correction in the student's style. In the objective space, the reasoning is weighted by its contribution to the action. A role-asymmetric KL anchor allows the corrected action to move freely while keeping the reasoning near the student's prior. On the TimeWarp benchmark, WebKD students gain about 5.5-10.7 pp over behavior cloning, outcome-reward RL, and teacher editing baselines. The performance transfers to unseen versions and to the live web in the OnlineMind2Web benchmark. WebKD opens a new way of distilling black-box models to improve the capabilities of open-weight web agents.

items.title: CTIA-ODE: Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
items.title_zh: CTIA-ODE：用于长期时间序列预测的连续时间变量间注意力
items.summary_zh: 尽管多元时间序列预测具有广阔的应用前景，但有效纳入外生变量仍然具有挑战性。流行的离散时间架构通常会在异构变量之间施加严格的时间对齐，这可能会限制它们捕获不断变化的外部影响的能力。为了解决这个限制，我们引入了 CTIA-ODE，这是一种以连续时间变量间注意力（CTIA）为中心的连续时间预测框架。具体来说，CTIA 嵌入在常微分方程 (ODE) 求解器中，使不断演化的内生轨迹能够沿着积分路径动态查询静态外生上下文，而无需显式时间对齐。为了提高连续潜在动态的稳定性，我们进一步引入了双重稳定策略：在架构上，线性残差增强（LRA）模块提供了宏观趋势锚定，而异常值稳健混合损失（ORHL）则减轻了优化过程中重尾异常的影响。在八个真实世界数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，CTIA-ODE 在不同数据集和预测范围内实现了最先进的预测性能，同时通过紧凑的内存占用和低推理延迟保持了有利的准确性与效率权衡，特别是在长范

extra.description: Although multivariate time series forecasting has broad application prospects, effectively incorporating exogenous variables remains challenging. Prevailing discrete-time architectures often impose rigid temporal alignment across heterogeneous variables, which may limit their ability to capture continuously evolving external effects. To address this limitation, we introduce CTIA-ODE, a continuous-time forecasting framework centered on Continuous-Time Inter-Variable Attention (CTIA). Specifically, CTIA is embedded within an ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver, enabling the continuously evolving endogenous trajectory to dynamically query a static exogenous context along the integration path without requiring explicit temporal alignment. To improve the stability of the continuous latent dynamics, we further introduce a dual-stabilization strategy: architecturally, a Linear Residual Augmentation (LRA) module provides a macroscopic trend anchor, while an Outlier-Robust Hybrid Loss (ORHL) mitigates the influence of heavy-tailed anomalies during optimization. Extensive experiments across eight real-world datasets demonstrate that CTIA-ODE achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance across diverse datasets and prediction horizons, while maintaining a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off with a compact memory footprint and low inference latency, particularly under long-horizon forecasting settings. Anonymous code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CTIA-ODE-15A6/.

items.title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
items.title_zh: ActionOPD：提炼决策，而不是代币
items.summary_zh: 将有能力的语言模型代理提炼成更小的模型需要使学生的行为与教师的行为保持一致。这就提出了一个基本问题：应该在哪些状态和什么粒度下执行这种对齐？离线模仿提供了密集但特定于​​代币的监督，并且可能会遭受状态分布不匹配的影响。令牌级在策略蒸馏（OPD）解决了这种不匹配问题，但通常需要教师令牌概率和兼容的令牌化。我们认为语义动作为代理蒸馏提供了一个自然的监督单元。我们引入了 ActionOPD，这是一种动作级别的策略蒸馏方法，其动机是最大化学生遇到的状态下的预期教师动作可能性。在每个这样的状态下，ActionOPD 对学生和黑盒教师的动作进行采样，根据学生的动作与采样的教师动作的语义一致性来奖励学生的动作。通过策略优化，ActionOPD 将学生的行动级别行为与教师的决策保持一致，而无需复制教师编写的推理或访问教师令牌概率。由两名教师对 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 进行多样化、策划的工具

extra.description: Distilling capable language-model agents into smaller models requires aligning the student's behavior with the teacher's. This raises a fundamental question: at which states and at what granularity should this alignment be performed? Offline imitation provides dense but token-specific supervision and can suffer from state-distribution mismatch. Token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this mismatch but typically requires teacher token probabilities and compatible tokenization. We argue that semantic actions provide a natural unit of supervision for agent distillation. We introduce ActionOPD, an action-level on-policy distillation method motivated by maximizing expected teacher-action likelihood at student-encountered states. At each such state, ActionOPD samples actions from both the student and a black-box teacher, rewarding student actions according to their semantic agreement with the sampled teacher actions. Through policy optimization, ActionOPD aligns the student's action-level behavior with the teacher's decisions without requiring reproduction of teacher-written reasoning or access to teacher token probabilities. Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with two teachers on diverse, curated tool-use tasks yields average gains of 3.3-6.9 percentage points across four out-of-distribution benchmarks. ActionOPD scales favorably with student size and teacher capability, without requiring the teacher and student to share a model family or tokenizer. On $τ^2$-bench, ActionOPD achieves competitive performance against offline distillation and token-level OPD. We further explore Self-ActionOPD with a same-model teacher and privileged context. These results establish ActionOPD as a promising approach to agent distillation.

items.title: One Monitor Does Not Fit All: Formalism-Agnostic Runtime Verification for Agentic AI
items.title_zh: 一台显示器并不能满足所有需求：代理 AI 的形式主义无关的运行时验证
items.summary_zh: 代理人工智能系统结合了模型决策、可变状态、工具调用和委托给外部代理。监控它们需要从不同的执行边界进行观察，而预防则需要在操作产生效果之前进行控制。我们提出了 AgenticRV，一种运行时验证架构，它将这些边界与监控形式分开。适配器发出规范事件；每个监视器都有自己的投影和抽象；决策策略使用标准化判决来选择负责适配器支持的反应。当观察足够时，我们就将其形式化，监控替换可以保留决策，而阻止可以防止不安全的影响。我们还将拒绝的尝试与已完成的效果区分开来，避免假设被阻止的请求必须使每个监视器处于永久违规状态。 Python 实现支持 LangGraph、MCP 和 A2A。受控 LangGraph 实验将外部 Reelay 时间监视器与编程报告监视器相结合；消融显示了为什么所选要求需要两者。差异检查和跨适配器测试提供了进一步的集成证据。 LLM 驱动的事件响应示例说明了相同的执行路径，而现有的微基

extra.description: Agentic AI systems combine model decisions, mutable state, tool calls, and delegation to external agents. Monitoring them requires observations from different execution boundaries, while prevention requires control before an operation produces its effect. We present AgenticRV, a runtime-verification architecture that separates these boundaries from the monitoring formalism. Adapters emit canonical events; each monitor receives its own projection and abstraction; and a decision policy uses normalised verdicts to select a reaction supported by the responsible adapter. We formalise when observations suffice, monitor replacement preserves decisions, and blocking prevents unsafe effects. We also distinguish rejected attempts from completed effects, avoiding the assumption that a blocked request must leave every monitor in a permanent violation state. The Python implementation supports LangGraph, MCP, and A2A. A controlled LangGraph experiment combines an external Reelay temporal monitor with a programmatic report monitor; ablations show why both are needed for the selected requirements. Differential checks and cross-adapter tests provide further integration evidence. An LLM-driven incident-response example illustrates the same enforcement path, while existing microbenchmarks isolate framework costs. The results support reuse of monitoring methods at explicit control boundaries, subject to the stated observation and deployment assumptions.

items.title: When Does Depth Help? Understanding Layerwise Inference in Tabular Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 深度何时有帮助？了解表格基础模型中的分层推理
items.summary_zh: 基于 Transformer 的表格基础模型 (TFM) 在中小型表格预测任务上实现了最先进的性能，同时通过共享层堆栈处理不同的输入。最近的分层分析发现了早期 TFM 表示中强大的预测性能以及跨层计算的大量重叠。然而，仅靠早期预测可访问性并不能确定后面的层是否对于每个输入都是可有可无的，并且聚合精度可能会掩盖哪些输入受益于额外的计算。我们研究了 TabPFN-3 跨 272 个分类数据集的所有 24 个上下文学习层，结合表示几何、预测轨迹、截断和结构干预，同时还检查了四个附加 TFM 中的相关表示动态。我们发现了一条明显的扩张-压缩轨迹，后期维度收缩更强，与类原型分离的更大增加相关。对早期稳定样本的有针对性的分析表明，在预测类别稳定后，显着的表征变化仍然存在，而局部模糊查询从浅层到后期获得的准确度增益比分离良好的查询更大。重复单个预训练块或扰动层顺序会平均降低预测性能，从而限制冻结模型中的

extra.description: Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on small to medium-sized tabular prediction tasks while processing diverse inputs through a shared stack of layers. Recent layerwise analyses identify strong predictive performance in early TFM representations and substantial overlap in computation across layers. However, early predictive accessibility alone does not establish whether later layers are dispensable for every input, and aggregate accuracy can obscure which inputs benefit from additional computation. We study all 24 in-context-learning layers of TabPFN-3 across 272 classification datasets, combining representation geometry, prediction trajectories, truncation, and structural interventions, while also examining related representation dynamics in four additional TFMs. We uncover a pronounced expansion-compression trajectory, with stronger late dimensional contraction associated with larger increases in class-prototype separation. A targeted analysis of early-stabilizing samples shows that substantial representational changes persist after predicted classes stabilize, while locally ambiguous queries obtain larger accuracy gains from shallow to late layers than well-separated queries. Repeating a single pretrained block or perturbing layer order reduces predictive performance on average, constraining simple post-hoc substitutions in the frozen model. These findings distinguish predictive accessibility, class stability, and the benefits of continuing computation, supporting an input-dependent assessment of depthwise redundancy in TFMs.

items.title: Learning Perception to Action Rules through Reinforcement Learning for Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
items.title_zh: 通过心理理论推理的强化学习学习对行动规则的感知
items.summary_zh: 在心理理论（ToM）推理中，大型语言模型可能会正确推断智能体的心理状态，但在预测或判断智能体的后续动作时无法使用该推理。在这项工作中，我们研究了将感知、信念和行动与规则明确联系起来是否可以改善 ToM 推理。我们生成简洁的 \textit{if--then} 规则来表达感知与行动之间的关系，并使用组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 跨四个 ToM 基准训练 Qwen2.5 和 Llama3 模型。具有规则生成功能的 GRPO 优于提示、监督微调和思考推理。此外，较大模型 ($\geq$3B) 生成的规则提供了可转移的知识，可提高 GPT-4o-mini 的下游性能。这些发现表明，显式规则有助于模型弥合 ToM 中的推理差距，并支持跨模型的知识迁移。

extra.description: In Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning, large language models may correctly infer the agent's mental state but fail to use that inference when predicting or judging the agent's subsequent actions. In this work, we investigate whether explicitly connecting perception, belief, and action with rules improves ToM reasoning. We generate concise \textit{if--then} rules that express relations between perception to action and use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to train Qwen2.5 and Llama3 models across four ToM benchmarks. GRPO with rule generation outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and think reasoning. Moreover, rules generated by larger models ($\geq$3B) provide transferable knowledge that improves downstream performance of GPT-4o-mini. These findings suggest that explicit rules help models bridge the reasoning gap in ToM and support knowledge transfer across models.

items.title: StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning
items.title_zh: StateCraft：用抽象状态推理增强视频世界模型
items.summary_zh: 视频世界模型旨在模拟具有逼真外观和动态的复杂环境。在长期交互​​中保持一致性需要跟踪过去的行为并了解这些行为如何影响环境。视频世界模型一次只能生成对整个世界的部分观察。在每种情况下，仅记住过去的观察结果可能并不够，因为它们可能不再反映一系列行动之后的世界。我们引入了一种范例，将持久的、可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦。抽象状态跟踪实体随着世界的演变而发生的变化，并用于调节代表当前视图的视觉状态。我们提出了 StateCraft，这是一种新颖的架构，它将语言模型与视频扩散模型配对以发展动态世界。我们评估了我们在生成界面上的方法，这构成了巨大的挑战，因为单个动作可能会改变当前不可见的部分状态。为了支持培训和评估，我们开发了一个数据收集管道，可以在没有人工或代理监督的情况下大规模生成信息丰富、密集注释的轨迹，以及衡量生成质量、内存和可控性的基准。在此基准上，我们的方法改进超过了最先进的基线。我们证

extra.description: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities' changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft, a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. We evaluate our approach on generative interfaces, which pose a substantial challenge because a single action may change parts of the state that are not currently visible. To support training and evaluation, we develop a data collection pipeline that produces informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale without human or agent supervision, together with a benchmark measuring generation quality, memory, and controllability. On this benchmark, our approach improves surpasses the state-of-the-art baselines. We demonstrate that StateCraft maintains high self-consistency and strong generation quality over long trajectories. Because the abstract state is explicit, it can be edited directly, and generation follows edits to states never observed in the data. Finally, a proof-of-concept 3D experiment, in which actions change the illumination of an unobserved room, shows that the paradigm can also be applied to spatial environments. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/.
